findings.evidence: We will only use the personal information you provide for its intended purpose.
findings.rationale: The policy denies collecting contact details and instead refers to personal information broadly.

findings.evidence: Session cookies do not contain personal information and once you close your browser, the cookies disappear. The Library uses session cookies on our site for technical purposes such as to enable you to more easily navigate throughout the Library's websites. Session cookies only collect non-personally identifiable data.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions session cookies being used for technical purposes but does not specify 'Service Operation and Security' as a purpose.

findings.evidence: The Library of Congress strives to provide the best experience for our Web and SMS users. To that end, the Library automatically collects and stores the following non-personally identifiable information: The name of the domain from which you access the Internet, The Internet Protocol address of your Internet provider's gateway, or in some cases, the computer you are using, The date and time you access the Library's site, The URL of the pages you visit and files you download, The Internet address of the website from which you linked directly to our site, Characteristics of your system, and Search terms used to come to the site and while on the site (in aggregate only).
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly mentions automatic collection of non-personally identifiable information, which includes characteristics of the system and search terms, but does not mention collecting location data.

findings.evidence: We will not disclose your personal information to other outside parties without first obtaining your permission.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that the IP address and device IDs are shared with Google AdMob, but it does mention that personal information is disclosed to contractors or associates without consent.
The policy does not explicitly state that it does not track or monitor children's data for advertising purposes.
